## Scope and evidence standard

This interprets a bounded controller-development result. The redesigned experimental controller changes scientific behavior, so the stopped earlier line is negative evidence only and cannot validate it. Accuracy, component classification, qualified ranking and operational economics are assessed separately, and unrun gates are reported as unrun. No amortization or saving is invented.

- first candidate cold {{measure8_original075_cold_complete_update_s}}, cached {{measure8_original075_cached_complete_update_s}}

Because preparation alone is a large share of an interval that already misses the deadline, shortening the timer with the same kernel has no measured route to the requirement. This gate must not be overridden.

## Frozen local advancement gate — failed

Every local measurement selects initialization ({{measure8_original075_cold_selected_iteration}}, {{measure8_original075_cached_selected_iteration}}, {{measure8_original15_cold_selected_iteration}}, {{measure8_original15_cached_selected_iteration}}) with zero objective improvement ({{measure8_original075_cold_objective_improvement}}, {{measure8_original075_cached_objective_improvement}}, {{measure8_original15_cold_objective_improvement}}, {{measure8_original15_cached_objective_improvement}}). ## Causality versus single-snapshot termination intervention

This supports termination as a sufficient local cause at that snapshot; it is not unique causality. Confounders: bitwise initial state and prior warm plans differ; derivative/conditioning amplification outside the tested snapshot remains possible; the second candidate's earliest above-threshold command discrepancy is tiny at an equal iteration index, so timing is not a demonstrated unique cause there; cold local runs differ from original hot runtime/cache history; the relative-improvement criterion is conditional, not an unconditional floor; no observed backend decisions were fed to the forecast, and the deterministic diagnostic cap was preregistered independently rather than adopted for production agreement.

## Preserved negative evidence

The stopped study failed metric accuracy on both candidates, flagged a false-feasible holding-speed and joint classification on one, and its ranking was resolved and directionally correct but not useful, with no realized avoided evaluations or savings. This is retained as negative development evidence and cannot validate the redesigned controller.

## Classification, ranking and economics — unrun

No matched pair, no cheaper screening family and no formal prospective case ran. The deterministic diagnostic cap carries no elimination authority. Forecast–backend agreement was not demonstrated, no pair ordering or candidate rejection is claimed, and no positive counterfactual new saving exists. Unused protected slots were preserved and immutable artifacts retained.
